189 | def build_scenarios(
190 |         self, conditions: dict[str, Set[bool]], region: str | None = None
191 |     ) -> Iterator[dict[str, bool]]:
192 |         """Given a list of condition names this function will
193 |         yield scenarios that represent those conditions and
194 |         there result (True/False)
195 | 
196 |         Args:
197 |             condition_names (list[str]): A list of condition names
198 | 
199 |         Returns:
200 |             Iterator[dict[str, bool]]: yield dict objects of {ConditionName: True/False}
201 |         """
202 |         # nothing to yield if there are no conditions
203 |         if len(conditions) == 0:
204 |             return
205 | 
206 |         c_cnf = self._cnf.copy()
207 |         condition_names = []
208 |         conditions_set = {}
209 |         for condition_name, values in conditions.items():
210 |             if condition_name in self._conditions:
211 |                 if values == {True}:
212 |                     c_cnf.add_prop(
213 |                         self._conditions[condition_name].build_true_cnf(
214 |                             self._solver_params
215 |                         )
216 |                     )
217 |                     conditions_set[condition_name] = True
218 |                     continue
219 |                 if values == {False}:
220 |                     c_cnf.add_prop(
221 |                         self._conditions[condition_name].build_false_cnf(
222 |                             self._solver_params
223 |                         )
224 |                     )
225 |                     conditions_set[condition_name] = False
226 |                     continue
227 |             condition_names.append(condition_name)
228 | 
229 |         try:
230 |             # build a large matric of True/False options
231 |             # based on the provided conditions
232 |             scenarios_attempted = 0
233 |             if region:
234 |                 products = itertools.starmap(
235 |                     self.build_scenerios_on_region,
236 |                     itertools.product(condition_names, [region]),
237 |                 )
238 |             else:
239 |                 products = itertools.product([True, False], repeat=len(condition_names))  # type: ignore
240 | 
241 |             for p in products:
242 |                 cnf = c_cnf.copy()
243 |                 params = dict(zip(condition_names, p))
244 |                 for condition_name, opt in params.items():
245 |                     if opt:
246 |                         cnf.add_prop(
247 |                             self._conditions[condition_name].build_true_cnf(
248 |                                 self._solver_params
249 |                             )
250 |                         )
251 |                     else:
252 |                         cnf.add_prop(
253 |                             self._conditions[condition_name].build_false_cnf(
254 |                                 self._solver_params
255 |                             )
256 |                         )
257 | 
258 |                 # if the scenario can be satisfied then return it
259 |                 if satisfiable(cnf):
260 |                     yield {**params, **conditions_set}
261 | 
262 |                 scenarios_attempted += 1
263 |                 # On occassions people will use a lot of non-related conditions
264 |                 # this is fail safe to limit the maximum number of responses
265 |                 if scenarios_attempted >= self._max_scenarios:
